description: This is a test class for the AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPI in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing API endpoints related to attendance punch-out record overlap functionality. It includes tests for retrieving a single record and placeholders for update, delete, and validation rules.

classes.name: AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the AttendancePunchOutRecordOverlapAPI, testing the retrieval and handling of punch-out record overlaps in the OrangeHRM attendance API.
